cost_scope.itp_model: All metered model CLI attempts for this execution.
cost_scope.queue_and_elapsed: Stage wall_seconds starts after resource-slot admission. Waiting is reported in queue_seconds. The outer attempts[].wall_seconds is end-to-end elapsed time, including waits and orchestration; it is separate from phase costs.
cost_scope.itp_coq_and_itp_kernel: Sum of checks[].stages and resource_protection_replays[].stages in locally completed proof rounds, partitioned by stage. Separately referenced shared checks and resource_replays are outside these totals.
cost_scope.resource_protection_replays: All measured stages of these additional identical-input replays are already included once in itp_coq and itp_kernel. Each links to its prior attempt by original_attempt_sha256.
cost_scope.resource_replays: If an interrupted original lost its RSS, its additional replay is recorded here. itp_coq_comparable substitutes the matched replay; itp_coq_total_observed_wall_seconds adds both attempts.
cost_scope.itp_binding_and_shared_check: itp_binding measures matching to archived evidence. Charge the referenced cold proof once by shared_check.id when comparing cohorts.
